title: The 10 Best Pool Covers
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for pool covers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pool covers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: WaterWarden Premium Pool Safety Cover for 12x20 Ft In-Ground Pool
products.blurb: Key specs: UL-classified per ASTM F1346, Solid vinyl construction blocks 100% of sunlight, 20-year warranty.
strengths: Actually load-bearing, not just a light debris coverto ASTM F1346 for foot traffic
Solid material blocks 100% of sunlight, which suppresses algae growth better than mesh
20-year warranty is among the longest of any safety cover in this roundup
Triple-stitched seams hold up to repeated spring tensioning over multiple seasons
limitations: Solid design means rainwater pools on top and requires a cover pump
Blocking all sunlight also blocks all solar heating, so it can't double as a warm-season cover
Heavier than mesh equivalents, harder for one person to remove and fold
Costs more upfront than mesh safety covers of similar size
features: Solid vinyl construction blocks 100% of sunlight
Rated to support adult foot traffic

products.name: GLI Secur-A-Pool 20x40 Ft Rectangular Mesh Safety Cover with Center End Step
products.blurb: Key specs: Polypropylene mesh, ASTM F1346-rated, Rated to hold multiple adults, Center end step cutout for pool access.
strengths: Center step cutout means you don't have to pull the whole cover to get in and out
Mesh sheds rainwater on its own, no cover pump to buy or run
Strong enough to support multiple adults, a real structural safety cover
Lighter and easier to handle solo than an equivalent solid cover
limitations: Mesh only blocks about 92% of sunlight, so algae control is weaker than a solid cover
Fine silt and pollen pass through the weave and settle on the pool floor
Large 20x40 size is still heavy and awkward to fold without a second person
Step cutout is a fixed hardware point that needs periodic inspection
features: Center end step cutout for pool access

products.name: Blue Wave NS420 16x32 Ft Rectangle Solar Pool Cover 12-Mil Blue
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-mil UV-stabilized polyethylene bubbles, 5-year seam warranty, 16x32 ft rectangle fit.
strengths: 12-mil thickness is the sweet spot between an 8-mil cover that tears too easily and a 16-mil cover that costs much more
5-year seam warranty beats most budget solar covers, which often carry no seam coverage at all
Fits standard 16x32 rectangular pools without custom cutting
limitations: Still a wear item, expect noticeable bubble degradation by year 4-5 even with the 5-year warranty
Needs a reel to handle without wrinkling or tearing at this size
Adds zero structural weight rating, cannot substitute for a safety cover
Heavier per square foot than an 8-mil cover, more work to remove and store

products.name: Pool Mate 18x33 Ft Blue/Silver Deluxe Oval Solar Cover 8-Mil
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-mil UV-stabilized bubble material, 18x33 ft oval fit, Blue/silver reflective surface.
strengths: One of the few widely-stocked solar covers cut specifically for 18x33 oval above-ground pools
8-mil thickness is light enough for one person to pull on and off without a reel
Lower price point than 12-mil or 16-mil covers of the same size
Reflective blue/silver surface helps limit surface heat loss overnight
limitations: 8-mil material typically lasts only 3-5 years versus 5-8 for 12/16-mil covers
Thinner bubbles puncture more easily on rough pool edges or ladders
Less heat retention than thicker covers, so temperature gain is more modest
Oval sizing is fixed, doesn't work for rectangular or freeform pools

products.name: Robelle 20x40 Ft Heavy Duty Green Winter Pool Cover for Inground Pools
products.blurb: Key specs: 8x8 scrim-reinforced polyethylene, 10-year warranty, 20x40 ft sizing with industry-standard 5-ft overlap.
strengths: 5-ft overlap is sized so water bags actually rest on solid deck instead of hanging off the edge
8x8 scrim reinforcement resists tearing from wind flap better than unreinforced tarps
10-year warranty is solid for a mid-tier winter tarp, not the cheapest but not the priciest either
Green color blocks sunlight well enough to meaningfully slow algae growth over winter
limitations: Not weight-rated, still a tarp, and should never be treated as a safety barrier
20x40 size is heavy and typically needs two people to install correctly
Requires separate water bags or anchoring hardware, sold apart from the cover
Standing water can pool on the surface without a cover pump in heavy rain
features: Compatible with water bags and cable anchoring

products.name: Blue Wave 21-Ft Round Above Ground Pool Winter Cover, 8-Year
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-year warranty, 21-ft round fit, Elastic cable-and-winch tensioning system.
strengths: Elastic cable system is faster to install than water bags around the full perimeter
21-ft round sizing matches the most common above-ground pool diameter
8-year warranty covers multiple winter seasons of UV and cold exposure
limitations: Not weight-rated, same as any winter tarp, don't let kids or pets walk on it
Shorter warranty than the Arctic Armor 15-year line at a similar price point
Cable-and-winch tensioning loosens over the season and needs occasional re-tightening
Standard woven material is more prone to wind flap tearing than scrim-reinforced tarps

products.name: Blue Wave Arctic Armor 12x20 Ft Oval Above Ground Pool Winter Cover, 15-Year
products.blurb: Key specs: 15-year warranty, Arctic Armor heavy-gauge fabric, 12x20 ft oval fit.
strengths: 15-year warranty is the longest of any winter cover in this roundup
Heavier Arctic Armor gauge resists wind flap and UV breakdown better than standard tarps
Tighter fit reduces the sagging and pooling that stresses seams over a full winter
Oval sizing is a less common fit that many budget lines don't stock
limitations: Priced noticeably above standard-gauge winter covers of the same size
Still not weight-rated, no substitute for an ASTM-rated safety cover
Heavier fabric makes it more cumbersome to fold and store than lighter tarps
12x20 oval sizing is fixed and won't fit rectangular or freeform above-ground pools

products.name: WaterWarden Inground Pool Safety Cover 20x40 Ft Rectangle, Blue Mesh
products.blurb: Key specs: ASTM F1346-rated mesh construction, 20x40 ft rectangular fit, No cover pump required.
strengths: Lowest-cost entry into a genuinely ASTM-certified safety cover, not a winter tarp marketed as one
Mesh drains rainwater on its own, avoiding the cover pump expense of solid covers
Spring-and-strap anchoring is the same structural approach used on premium safety covers
limitations: Mesh blocks only about 92% of sunlight, weaker algae suppression than a solid cover
Warranty terms trail WaterWarden's premium solid line
Fine debris and pollen still pass through the weave and settle on the pool floor
20x40 size is heavy enough that installation is easier with two people

products.name: Robelle 20x40 Ft Ultimate Charcoal Winter Pool Cover, 20-Year
products.blurb: Key specs: 20-year warranty, longest in the winter cover category, Ultimate heavy-duty charcoal fabric, 20x40 ft sizing.
strengths: 20-year warranty is roughly double what most winter tarps offer
Charcoal color absorbs more residual heat than green or blue tarps, helping limit ice stress on the pool wall
Ultimate-grade fabric is noticeably heavier gauge than Robelle's standard Heavy Duty line
limitations: Priced well above standard winter covers, a real premium for the extended warranty
Not weight-rated, same limitation as every winter tarp regardless of price
Heavier fabric is harder to fold and store than lighter-gauge covers
Dark color shows algae staining more visibly than lighter tarps if left too long
features: 20-year warranty, longest in the winter cover category

products.name: Blue Wave NS480 15-Ft Round Solar Blanket for Above-Ground Pools, 12-Mil Clear
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-mil UV-stabilized clear bubble material, 15-ft round fit, Cuts evaporation and raises water temperature.
strengths: Clear material lets more sunlight through than blue covers, which typically means slightly faster heat gain
12-mil thickness holds up better than budget 8-mil round covers
15-ft round is the most common above-ground pool diameter, widely compatible
limitations: Clear material shows algae and debris buildup more visibly than tinted covers
Still a wear item that needs replacement every 5-8 years depending on sun exposure
Requires a reel or careful folding to avoid creasing and premature cracking
No structural weight rating, cannot serve as a safety or winter cover
features: Cuts evaporation and raises water temperature

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
